cohort: frozen original 13 ImpactMesh activations and 516 chips
primary: floodwater AP by activation averaged over seeds

port_choices.teacher: common frozen MC teacher; train only encoder/attention with frozen BN, clean paired inputs
port_choices.unit: event reset and sampling of existing 256px tiles; no stride-64 retile
port_choices.terrain: unclipped archived GLO-30 HAND and DEM gradient slope; percentile scaling over valid pixels within an activation
port_choices.gate_c: paper unspecified; 2.0 is a fixed port value before scoring
port_choices.physics: VV-only matched information and original joint VV/VH cue with additional VH; label thresholds from PX1
port_choices.scoring: dry (0) and floodwater (2) on the original support; exclude permanent water and nodata
